author: Fouled
body:
Final Chance - TE

Map name: Final Chance
Creator: Fouled
Contributor(s): Tazz
Gamemode: TDM
Pictures: Album

Details

Blue vs Red
No scoreboxes & spawners (wouldn't work too well with this map)
3 different floor levels
Enough cover provided
1 golden apple & 4 arrows provided per kill

NOTE: May need a better map name

Feedback is highly appreciated and taken into consideration.

replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
Sadly I have to agree with the majority of replies; without the presence of spawners there is no rivalry to gain and hold territory, which therefore makes it completely useless for tournaments. 

I apologise for sounding so harsh, but as a public map, it could be very good.
